notes.title: Challenge mode, New items, Supporter DLC skins, Localizations Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Thank you so much for the overwhelming support since launch.
We’ve prepared an update for those of you craving even more challenging and creative delivery experiences!

Challenge Mode
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529495/663c6eeb5df1895098d499c8e6f62e97b6f0c886.png
Overcome tougher enemies and harsh penalties to complete your deliveries!
New items have been added to the reward pool for clearing Challenge Modes 1, 2, and 3.

Exclusive Appearance for Supporters
After clearing the base game on any difficulty, players who have purchased the Supporter DLC will gain access to special cosmetic options!

New Results Screen
It’s always satisfying to reflect on your perfectly built deck.
We’ve added a results screen that shows your inventory and gameplay stats upon clearing the game.

Localization Update
The following languages are now supported:

 Japanese
 Simplified Chinese
 Traditional Chinese
 Russian


Upcoming Content

More Challenge Mode Volumes
Additional difficulty levels with new penalties and rewards.

New Playable Class: Pizza Ninja
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529495/fcd1735d42ca94ea018aa3e3573486b5648a2cb6.png

More Gameplay Volume
New stages and scenarios, such as climbing back up to the surface from B15.

Leaderboard Support

Supporter DLC
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3576450/_____DLC/

Support us and gain access to exclusive cosmetics that will be added over time!

We hope you enjoy your deliveries!

notes.title: 1.0.1 hotfix
notes.notes:
- Adjusted drop rules for certain items. (Rifles and shotguns now appear at a low probability starting from floor 11.)
- Added missing English translations.
- Added flavor text for some items.

Thanks.
